verdict.rationale: The firm ships Visalaw AI, so a data-retention axis applies. Its only relevant claim is a vendor-stated 'no data retention' posture with SOC 2 Type II certification, which implies data is not kept. Nothing documents user-facing controls to set retention periods or delete data, and the claim is uncorroborated marketing copy. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, an explicit deletion mechanism or workflow, detailed retention/privacy policy documentation, independent or hands-on verification of the no-retention claim.
